provenance.source_title: Your Life as a Mercenary at Every Level

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（战地档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读你战地档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，用短句把你从五金店送上产业顶端；讲机制时像教官一样精确（读路/演练/防线），写代价时像记账员一样冷静（账户/错过/信件）；暴力只写后果与血渍，从不给慢镜头
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：升级时替你数钱，账单到时替你把账摊开，不安慰也不指责
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自岗位机制的可信（安保规程/车队/指挥/产业链）与判词的绝对克制

tone_profile.certainty_style: 机制用确定语气，判词短促如判；暴力只陈述事实不渲染

rhythm_rules.rule: 连续短句推进（平均7.7词，短句占63%），一个动作一句
rhythm_rules.function: 保持档案宣读式的宿命节拍

rhythm_rules.rule: 岗位机制用「规程清单+实战证明」配对
rhythm_rules.function: 让专业感既具体又可信

rhythm_rules.rule: 暴力只写后果与物证（血浸透袖子干掉/烟中的残骸）
rhythm_rules.function: 保持真实重量，避免动作片化

rhythm_rules.rule: 自我欺骗用语逐次复读并加码（再来一份/再一年，说了十年）
级间用章节卡硬切（Level X. The [身份]），身份即处境预告

pause_and_emphasis: 判词用单句成段（You are property now 式：To them, the dead are a line item.）
关键转折用短句独立落下（You are 28 and you say yes 式）
章节卡后接年龄/身份定格（You are 39 years old now.）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level four, the shooter.）
认知升级式开场（You move up to... / You realize...）
时间/身体跳转声明（Your knees and shoulders are wearing out.）
循环回收（Somewhere a young man just finished his enlistment.）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：仅行业自嘲处，家庭账单段不用
placement_rules: 行业自嘲（钱比任何规则跑得快/事故报告写了很多很多）
avoid_rules: 不拿死者或家人开玩笑
死亡、信件与离婚段落绝对不用幽默

language_patterns.formula: Level X. The [绰号]. You are [年龄] years old.
language_patterns.purpose: 零铺垫入场+处境预告

language_patterns.formula: The army gave you skills. It took your knees in return.
language_patterns.purpose: 一句话结清一段关系

language_patterns.formula: You do the work and you keep quiet.
language_patterns.purpose: 把残酷筛选归结为朴素动词

language_patterns.formula: Long hours of nothing wrapped around seconds of terror.
language_patterns.purpose: 写值守型工作的真实形状

language_patterns.formula: everyone out here is running from something. A divorce, a debt, a country...
language_patterns.purpose: 给边缘人群画像

language_patterns.formula: Your training takes over before your fear does.
language_patterns.purpose: 写演练在关键时刻的价值

language_patterns.formula: A team leader who looks weak loses his men.
language_patterns.purpose: 给领导者的情绪管理立规

language_patterns.formula: She reaches for Rachel instead. That hurts more than any wound ever has.
language_patterns.purpose: 让最无辜者用动作完成审判

language_patterns.formula: The truth is you are looking for the war. Part of you misses it. That scares you most of all.
language_patterns.purpose: 把对战争的想念写成最深的恐惧

language_patterns.formula: You tell yourself one more contract will make it safe. There is always one more contract.
language_patterns.purpose: 让自我欺骗自己现形

language_patterns.formula: To them, the dead are a line item. To you, the dead are men you ate breakfast beside.
language_patterns.purpose: 把同一份死亡写出两种重量

language_patterns.formula: You arrange the bodies and the paperwork. You arrange the silence, too.
language_patterns.purpose: 把隐藏劳动显性化

language_patterns.formula: You tell their wives they died serving something important. You do not tell them what the job really was.
language_patterns.purpose: 写安慰性谎言的结构

language_patterns.formula: You have been saying one more year for a decade.
language_patterns.purpose: 让一句安慰话自己崩塌

language_patterns.formula: You can read a hostile street in a glance. You cannot read your own daughter at the table.
language_patterns.purpose: 写能力在错误的地方发达

language_patterns.formula: You are a businessman whose product is violence.
language_patterns.purpose: 给事业的本质命名

language_patterns.formula: You send it without question. It is all you have left to give.
language_patterns.purpose: 写爱的剩余形态

language_patterns.formula: She did not hate you. She just stopped waiting.
language_patterns.purpose: 写比恨更冷的结束

language_patterns.formula: You answer every one as if your life depends on it. In a quiet way, it does.
language_patterns.purpose: 把夸张还原成事实

language_patterns.formula: The pay is four times his old salary. He has no idea what that number will cost him.
language_patterns.purpose: 把开场的诱因复制给新人物

preferred_traits: 军事/安保术语的通俗化（principal、convoy、perimeter、direct action）
精确数字与换算（4倍薪水/$18,000月薪/40人剩一半/数百万损失）
身体感与物证（blood on sleeve、shaking hands、cracked phone）

forbidden_style.rule: 暴力只写后果与物证，禁止血腥渲染
死亡、信件与家庭段落绝对不用幽默
产业机制保持揭露立场，禁止写成招募广告
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止大团圆收束，救赎只能是一根脆弱的线

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
